name: 阅读
description: Collins Reading for IELTS 全 12 单元。覆盖段落标题匹配、句子配对、摘要填空、信息匹配、特征匹配、多选、TFNG / YNNG 等全部题型技巧，核心能力是同义替换与干扰项识别。

examInfo.note: 3 篇文章（Passage 1 最简单），题材为学术/一般话题

units.title: Family matters

aims.examSkills: 段落结构分析、Matching Headings 标题匹配
aims.languageDevelopment: 主旨句写作、段落功能识别（引入/主体/结论）

examInfo.title: Matching Headings（标题匹配）
points: 题干形式：Choose the correct heading for sections A–E from the list of numbered headings i–ix。
列表标题数 > 段落数（9 个标题 vs 5 个段落）→ 存在多余选项，是干扰项。
每个正确的标题都是对段落主旨的概括（Each correct heading will summarise the main idea of a paragraph）。

examInfo.title: 段落三段式结构
points: 段落通常分三部分：Introduction（引入）/ main part（主体）/ conclusion（结论）。
段落首句通常是 topic sentence。
段落功能类型：states cause and effect（因果）、develops an argument（论证）、gives information / a description（信息/描述）、introduces the topic（引入）、contrasts（对比）、summarises（总结）。

examTips: Identifying the structure of a paragraph will not only help you to understand the text, but will also help you to locate information.（识别段落结构既帮你理解文本，也帮你定位信息）
Each correct heading will summarise the main idea of a paragraph.

techniques.name: Matching Headings 解题五步
techniques.detail: 1) 先看题目问的段落数 / 标题数 / 有多少标题不被使用 2) 通读每个段落首尾句，抓主旨 3) 从列表中选最能概括主旨的标题 4) 排除只含个别关键词的标题 5) 回读验证。

examples.en: i New families: beneficial or harmful?
v The disappearance of the traditional model

techniques.name: 干扰项特征：只含具体名词的标题
techniques.detail: 标题中出现段落里的某个具体名词（如 Political families、government reaction），往往只是段落的一个细节，不是主旨。主旨标题通常是抽象概括。

techniques.name: 主旨句的两种形态
techniques.detail: 主旨可能是定义型（给概念下定义）或观点型（提出主张）。

examples.en: Nicholson defines the traditional family as 'the unit of parents with children who live together'.
To have a society that is family-friendly, anti-discrimination laws will need to be introduced.

techniques.name: 信号词识别段落切换
techniques.detail: 段落功能切换常有信号词。看到这些词就知道进入了新逻辑块。

examples.en: However, traditional families do have some advantages:
There are two main reasons for this.

vocab.en: the bond between husband and wife

grammar.name: 定语从句（关系代词）
grammar.detail: 阅读中最高频的复杂句结构。that / which / who 引导，修饰前面的名词。

examples.en: a family-friendly society that would have less crime

grammar.name: 同位语（appositive）
grammar.detail: 紧跟名词后的解释性短语，用来介绍人名/机构全称。

grammar.name: 被动语态
grammar.detail: 学术文章高频。主动↔被动的转换常出现在 Matching Headings 与 TFNG 题目中。

examples.en: Parenting would become a school subject
examples.cn: （虚拟/被动）育儿将成为一门学校课程

exercises.title: Choose the correct heading for sections A–E from the list of numbered headings i–ix
exercises.limit: 答案写罗马数字（i–ix），有 4 个多余

units.title: Health care

aims.examSkills: 略读抓大意、扫读定位、图表填空、段落功能概括
aims.languageDevelopment: 信息流向判断（general→specific）、段落功能动词库

examInfo.title: Completing diagrams（图表填空）
points: 图表层级 = 原文层级（中心概念 → 分支）。
图表不一定包含原文全部信息（The diagram may not include all the information in the passage）。
字数限制通常为 NO MORE THAN FOUR WORDS。

examInfo.title: 信息流向判断
points: 阅读文章要能判断是 general → specific（先普遍规律，后具体案例）还是 specific → general。
本单元 Passage 1–4 结构：① 总起（所有社会都有脆弱群体 + 定义）② 社会观念（家庭责任 vs 国家责任）③ 对弱势群体态度的差异 + 财富分配 ④ 英国国家介入的历史（1601 Poor Law → 20 世纪初）= 由一般到具体。

examTips: The diagram may not include all the information in the passage.（图表不一定包含原文全部信息 → 漏掉的原文信息不必填）

techniques.name: 段落功能概括词库
techniques.detail: 写主旨句/概括段落时用标准动词，能直接提升 Coherence and Cohesion 分数。

examples.en: introduces the topic of vulnerable people by giving a definition
examples.cn: 通过给出定义引入弱势群体这一话题
描述 / 解释 / 讨论
举例 / 总结 / 对比

techniques.name: 扫读定位法（Scanning）
techniques.detail: 题干关键词 → 段落首尾句 + 信号词（However, In fact, Not until）。

examples.cn: 转折 → 段落重点常在此后

techniques.name: 图表填空的锚点定位
techniques.detail: 从图表分支词出发，在原文中找同义表达。已给的词（colours, lifestyle, social factors, type of employment, crust/tubes）都是定位锚点。

examples.cn: ← the two most common explanations for objective differences

examples.en: Influences on objective characteristics of bodies
examples.cn: ← The shapes of people's bodies are often actually linked to diets, type of employment and general quality of life

examples.en: genetic differences (height, weight, etc.) / changes as people age
attractive / ugly, young or old, short or tall, weak or strong
unhealthy foods / repetitive physically demanding work / worse housing conditions / disadvantaged neighbourhoods

grammar.name: 名词化 / 动名词主语
grammar.detail: 学术文本把动作变成名词，读懂是理解段落的关键。

examples.en: Not until the opening years of the twentieth century did the state become involved.

grammar.name: 被动语态：观点类表达
grammar.detail: 被动语态常用于表达社会对某群体的看法（态度、偏见）。

examples.en: may be seen as the result of…

fields.label: 分支 1
fields.given: Influences on objective characteristics of bodies

fields.label: 主观评价
fields.given: attractive / ugly, young or old, short or tall, weak or strong

aims.examSkills: 摘要匹配（扫读）、短答案题
aims.languageDevelopment: 人物/机构定位法、观点标记词

examInfo.title: Exam information: Short-answer questions
points: This task tests your ability to find and understand specific information in a passage that contains a lot of factual information and detail.
You will be given a passage and a set of questions. You will have to read the passage and use the detailed information to answer each question with a short answer（not a sentence）.
答的是短语，不是完整句子。

examInfo.title: Matching summaries 规则
points: Skim-read（扫读）the passage and match the summaries to the paragraphs.
有两个多余的摘要（There are two extra summaries you do not need）→ 有干扰项。

techniques.name: 人名 / 机构名定位法
techniques.detail: 摘要里若含人名、机构名，直接扫原文找到对应段落。这是最高效的定位方式。

examples.cn: → 找 Aaron Porter 出现的段落

examples.en: Lord Browne / Professor Les Ebdon / BP

techniques.name: 观点标记词定位法
techniques.detail: 找 warned、said、argued、criticised、defended 等词，能定位到「反应类」段落。

examples.cn: → 找 NUS 说话/被引用的段落

examples.en: Detailed information about the review recommendations
examples.cn: → 找含具体数字/条款的段落

techniques.name: 「含数字的段落」= 数据类摘要
techniques.detail: 要摘要「详细建议」，就去含具体金额、百分比的段落。

examples.cn: → Browne 报告的具体条款数字

techniques.name: 同义替换对照（Matching summaries 核心）
techniques.detail: 摘要用词往往不是原文用词，要建立双向映射。

examples.en: graduates repay loans ≈ pay back student loans

examples.cn: 工会领袖 ≈ 全国学生会

vocab.cn: 空白支票（不受限制的授权）

grammar.name: 间接引语（reported speech）
grammar.detail: 阅读中常见的「他说……」要还原成陈述句理解。

grammar.name: 强调句与倒装
grammar.detail: It is ... who ... 用于强调主语，干扰句子结构理解。

exercises.title: Matching summaries（有两个多余摘要）

fields.label: Detailed information about the review recommendations
The reaction of unions and newer universities

exercises.limit: 答案写段落字母，多 2 个干扰摘要

units.title: Water
units.topic: Nature and the environment（自然与环境）

aims.examSkills: 句子配对（用句末词预测下一个语法词）
aims.languageDevelopment: 正式 vs 非正式词汇、词的「使用场合」而非「词义」

examInfo.title: Exam information: Matching sentence endings
points: This task tests your ability to understand the main ideas of specific sentences in a passage.
You will be given a set of sentence beginnings, a set of sentence endings and a passage. The sentence beginnings are based on information in the passage.
把句子开头与最合适的句子结尾匹配。
开头多于结尾（Exercise 2 为 8 个开头 vs 8 个结尾，其中多出的一个类型为 "extra type of word"）→ 存在干扰项。

examTips: When matching sentences, use the final words in the sentence beginnings to predict the next grammatical word.（用句首的最后一个词预测下一个语法词）
watchOuts: Think about when and how a word is used – not just the meaning of a word. The formality of a word varies according to the situation and the people involved.（不只看词义，更要看词在什么场合被使用；正式度随情境与人物而变）

techniques.name: 句末词 → 预测下一个语法词
techniques.detail: 这是句子配对题的核心方法。看句首最后一个词属于哪一类，就知道后面该接什么。

examples.cn: 介词 for 后接名词
介词 of 后接名词或动名词
about 后接名词或动名词

examples.en: accepted the link + linking phrase (between A and B)
save a further £3 billion + noun / preposition (in/on/over)

techniques.name: 识别词性（Understanding types of words）
techniques.detail: 选项框里的词分属：linking word / phrase、noun (or pronoun)、noun phrase、preposition。填空前先判断空格需要哪一类。

examples.en: until something goes wrong and they are in breach of legislation
up to 80 percent of environmental crimes
have neither the time nor the personnel to manage their environmental responsibilities
such as switching off machines that are not in use

techniques.name: 正式 vs 非正式词汇（水的两套词）
techniques.detail: 正式场合用专业词，口语用日常词。考试读学术文章要用正式那套。

examples.en: dam / drought / flood / lagoon / liquid / reef / reservoir / sandbank / seabed / silt

grammar.name: 动名词与不定式作宾语
grammar.detail: think about + doing；save + doing；to manage ...（不定式作目的状语）。

examples.en: don't think about switching off machines

grammar.name: 并列与指代
grammar.detail: neither … nor …；both … and …；they / their / them 替代名词（指代还原是句子配对的关键）。

examples.en: have neither the time nor the personnel
machines that are not in use

exercises.title: Matching sentence endings（8 个开头 ↔ 8 个结尾）
exercises.limit: 答案写结尾字母；有 1 个多余类型

units.title: Non-verbal clues

aims.examSkills: 多选题、全文概括、信息匹配
aims.languageDevelopment: 前缀构词法推断词义、动词 + 介词搭配

examInfo.title: Exam information: Multiple-choice questions
points: This task tests a wide range of reading skills, from an overall understanding of the passage to a detailed understanding of specific points.
You will be given a passage and a set of multiple-choice questions. The questions have multiple options and the instructions will tell you how many are correct (one, two or three).

examInfo.title: Matching information
points: Read the passage again and match the ideas to the paragraphs. There is one extra idea.（多一个干扰项）
备选 idea 池示例：active listening、communication skills in sales、good management、increase profits、what 'good communication' means。

examTips: Learning word patterns, like which prepositions follow a verb, is another simple way to increase your lexical knowledge. It will help you understand the meaning of sentences and details in the exam.
watchOuts: Learning prefixes is a useful way to work out the meaning of specific details. Think about the meaning of the base word and then apply the meaning of the prefix: illegal entry = an entry that is the opposite of legal, so the entry is not legal.

techniques.name: 前缀构词法推断词义
techniques.detail: 读懂前缀 = 读懂生词。考试里 illegal / incomplete / illegible / miscommunication 这类词全靠前缀推断。

examples.en: re- / pre- / over- / under- / sub- / inter- / co-
examples.cn: 中性前缀（receive / pre- / over / under / sub / inter / co）

techniques.name: 动词 + sign 的搭配族
techniques.detail: 一个动词多个介词/宾语搭配，每个都是独立考点。

examples.en: sign away their rights to compensation
sign up for the broadband offer
sign in progress with the repair work
sign in before they can enter the conference hall

techniques.name: 全文概括：干扰项的两个特征
techniques.detail: 选 best summary 时，错误选项通常是：① 范围过窄/片面 ② 过于具体、只覆盖片段。正确摘要必须覆盖全文核心。

examples.cn: 只讲 communication skills 对 business 的重要性（范围过窄）
只覆盖 managers 对 customers 的做法（过于具体）
沟通是销售的核心：倾听、共情、建立关系、active listening

techniques.name: 题干关键词 → 原文定位
techniques.detail: 在题目中划出关键词/短语，再扫读定位。

examples.en: Q1 Why has it been difficult to establish a link between the calls of monkeys and people's musical preferences?
examples.cn: → 定位 'it took scientists a long time to establish a link between monkeys' calls and human music'

examples.en: Q3 Is it true that monkeys appeared calmer when listening to the rock band Metallica?
examples.cn: → 关键词 calmer / rock band Metallica

examples.en: Q4 Who suggested this new kind of study to Professor Snowdon?

vocab.en: bottom line of a business' finances

grammar.name: 动词 + 介词搭配
grammar.detail: 介词后接名词或动名词。

grammar.name: 动名词作主语 + 分词状语
grammar.detail: 「Returning goods, refunds and the loss of repeat custom…」；「Not listening costs money in the world of sales」。

examples.en: Returning goods, refunds and the loss of repeat custom
Not listening costs money in the world of sales – returned goods, refunds…

exercises.title: Match the ideas to the paragraphs（有一多余 idea）

units.title: Scientists at work

aims.examSkills: 图表填空与标注、扫读定位
aims.languageDevelopment: 词根后缀构词、科学家职业名词

examInfo.title: Completing diagrams / Diagram labelling
points: Read the passage and complete the diagrams. Use a dictionary if necessary.
先看图找层级：中心节点 "Scientific topics" 5 个分支；"Scientific equipment" 4 个分支。
图表不一定涵盖原文全部信息（Exam tutor: Does the diagram represent all the information in the passage? → No）。
每格 NO MORE THAN FOUR WORDS。

watchOuts: Knowing the origins of a word can help you work out its meaning.
The noun for a person who works in a particular science often ends in -er or -ist. Another common ending is -ian, e.g. statistician.

techniques.name: 学科后缀 -ology / -metry / -graphy / -ics
techniques.detail: 背下这些后缀 = 打开整片学科词汇。

examples.cn: → biology, ecology, geology, palaeontology, pharmacology, meteorology, psychology, sociology

techniques.name: 希腊语词根拆解
techniques.detail: 知道词根 = 看到生词也能猜出大致意思。

techniques.name: 科学家职业名词：动词 + -er / -ist / -ian
techniques.detail: 由「做什么」推出「谁在做」。

techniques.name: 图表填空的扫读技巧
techniques.detail: 从图表每个分支词出发，在原文中找同义表达。

examples.en: cell division / tooth decay / cloning / gene therapy
The Institute of Cell and Molecular Science (ICMS)

techniques.name: 地图标注：已知项 + 常识 + 上下文
techniques.detail: 用已知锚点推断缺失词。数字题注意单位与表达形式：图中已给单位，答题处只填数字；反之要带单位。

vocab.cn: 试管/烧瓶/显微镜/离心机
埃亚菲亚德拉霍尔火山

grammar.name: 名词后缀构词
grammar.detail: -er / -ist / -ian 表示从事某学科的人。这是构词法（词汇）与语法交叉的考点。

grammar.name: 定语从句 where 引导
grammar.detail: 先行词是地点/场所时用 where。

examples.en: a special pod or room with many interactive screens – where they can learn about the basics of cell biology and genetics

grammar.name: 被动语态
grammar.detail: 科研文章大量使用被动。

units.title: The job market

aims.examSkills: 摘要填空、预测缺词词性、略读定位
aims.languageDevelopment: 行业与职业描述的同义替换

examInfo.title: Summary completion 规则（Exam tutor 五问）
points: What can you predict about the missing word? → 根据语法/词性预测（冠词后填名词、单复数）
Why is it a good strategy to skim the passage first? → 先 skimming 掌握段落大意，再定位细节
Which paragraphs will be relevant to the summary? → 摘要对应特定几个段落，其余是干扰
What are the different types of summaries in this task? → 原文摘要 / 改写摘要 / 关键词摘要（关键词摘要拼写必须与原文一致）
What is the word limit for your answers? → 按题目要求（如 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS）

watchOuts: Remember to learn the correct spelling of new words. Incorrect spelling means an incorrect answer in the exam.

techniques.name: 行业 → 描述 同义替换表
techniques.detail: 考试中行业/职业常以释义形式出现，必须建立双向对应表。

examples.cn: providing expert advice to a company or organization
the business of farming land or animals to make food or drink
building houses, factories, roads, bridges, etc.

techniques.name: 摘要填空的定位技巧
techniques.detail: 先看摘要对应的段落范围，再看表格标题/小标题，最后用数据型关键词定位。

examples.en: The key information is contained in the subject tables, which now cover every area of higher education.
climbers at the top of the table / up from 43 to 28 / remains the top university

techniques.name: 干扰段落识别
techniques.detail: 解释「为什么表格只有这么多行」的段落（如某大学拒绝公布数据）通常不是摘要考点。

examples.en: The number of institutions in this year's tables has increased by only one because a fourth university – the West of Scotland – has instructed the Higher Education Statistics Agency not to release its data.

grammar.name: 比较级与最高级
grammar.detail: 排名类文章的核心语法。

grammar.name: 定语从句与被动语态
grammar.detail: 排名文章常用非限制性定语从句补充说明。

examples.en: a fourth university – the West of Scotland – which has instructed…
has increased by only one / instructed the Agency not to release its data

exercises.title: University & college rankings（Summary completion）
exercises.limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS；关键词摘要拼写须与原文一致

units.title: Life's journey
units.topic: Youth and life stages（青年与人生阶段）

aims.examSkills: TFNG 判定、题目顺序定位、主题定位、改述
aims.languageDevelopment: 人生事件搭配、人生阶段排序

examInfo.title: Exam information: True / False / Not Given
points: TRUE – if the text confirms the statement（原文证实了陈述）
FALSE – if the text confirms the opposite of the statement（原文证实了陈述的相反内容）
NOT GIVEN – if it is impossible to know from the text（无法从原文得知）
绝对禁止使用个人知识（常识、现实经验一律不算依据）。

examTips: The questions are in the same order as the text. For example, the information you need for Question 3 will be after Question 2 and before Question 4.
You must only use the information in the passage when deciding if a statement is true or false. Do not use your own personal knowledge of the subject.

techniques.name: TFNG 三分法核心
techniques.detail: TRUE = 一致；FALSE = 矛盾；NOT GIVEN = 原文未涉及（不是「你没读懂」）。判定顺序：先找原文证据 → 再看是「一致」「相反」还是「没提」。

examples.en: "Unemployment is now worse than it has ever been over the last fourteen years." → 原文 '14-year high'
"The majority of McDonald's employees are over 60." → 原文 '20 percent higher in those branches employing workers over 60'
"The supermarkets Tesco, Asda and Sainsbury's are larger than Morrisons."
"Morrisons supermarket is financially in a good position at the moment." → 原文 'among the biggest recruiters'
"Two thirds of the jobs at Morrisons will be taken up by people between 25 and 75." → 原文 'aged 18 to 24'
"Morrisons needs more people to work on their tills." → 原文 butchers, bakers and fishmongers + checkers

techniques.name: 数量 / 范围的偷换陷阱
techniques.detail: TFNG/YNNG 最常见的失分原因。原文是 a third，题目写 two thirds；原文是 more than one in six，题目写 a majority。

examples.en: "More than one in six young people are out of work"

techniques.name: 人生事件搭配与时间轴排序
techniques.detail: 把 life events 按时间轴排列，是本单元 Part 1 的核心练习。

examples.en: maternity leave / career break / mortgage / newlywed / honeymoon / sabbatical / promotion / rent a flat / retire
baby → maternity leave → career break → mortgage / newlywed → honeymoon → sabbatical → promotion → rent → retirement

techniques.name: 主题定位 + 改述
techniques.detail: 先给文章分块，再对每块提问。改述训练是 TFNG 的基础。

examples.en: people getting married later ↔ the trend is to get married later in life

grammar.name: 数字与百分数的同义替换
grammar.detail: 最高频的 TFNG 考点。

examples.en: a '14-year high' ↔ worse than it has ever been over the last fourteen years

grammar.name: 现在完成时 vs 过去时
grammar.detail: 现在完成时（have been waiting longer）强调对现在的影响；阅读中易被误判为过去事件。

exercises.title: Do the following statements agree with the information given in the following text?

fields.label: Unemployment is now worse than it has ever been over the last fourteen years.
The majority of McDonald's employees are over 60.
The supermarkets Tesco, Asda and Sainsbury's are larger than Morrisons.
Morrisons supermarket is financially in a good position at the moment.
Two thirds of the jobs at Morrisons will be taken up by people between 25 and 75.
Morrisons needs more people to work on their tills.

exercises.limit: 答案写 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN

units.title: Community spirit

aims.examSkills: 信息匹配（段落可重复匹配、部分段落不匹配）
aims.languageDevelopment: 段落信息类型识别（比较/描述/解释）

examInfo.title: Matching information 规则
points: Match the paragraphs A–C to the specific information 1–3. You can use any letter more than once.
Which paragraphs mention the following information? You may use any letter more than once.（7 段 A–G 对 6 个信息项）
不是每个段落都会被用到（有的段落不匹配任何信息）。
一个段落可能匹配多条信息。
答案写段落字母（A–G）。

examTips: In this task, there could be parts of the text that will not match any information and there could be parts that will be matched more than once.
For your answer, write the letter of the correct paragraph/part.

techniques.name: Matching information 解题四步
techniques.detail: 1) 给每条信息划关键词 2) 扫每段首句找对应 3) 允许重复使用字母 4) 排除「只提到相关话题但不含所需具体信息」的段落。

examples.en: a plan to prevent something from happening → A 段 'Add the post office closure programme into the mix'；C 段 'There will also be post office facilities'
the number of facilities disappearing → A 段 '600 country shops closed last year… thousands of neighbourhood hubs are being removed'
an example of a fund-raising activity → B 段 '241 people bought £50 shares, with another £5,000 coming from local donations and nearly £40,000 from charitable schemes'

techniques.name: 段落信息类型识别
techniques.detail: 快速判断段落是「比较」「描述」还是「解释」，帮助你在匹配时抓准。

examples.cn: In geometry, the shortest distance between two points is a straight line. In politics, if you have a local issue…
There is a lack of infrastructure, lack of amenities, and a risk of flooding
The reason the bad estates… Another big problem is ghost estates

techniques.name: 题干关键词 → 原文近义表达
techniques.detail: 匹配题几乎不会原词复现，必须做语义转换。

examples.en: the benefits of asking around → 'ask for the vendor's phone number', meet the neighbours
the relationship between local environment and behaviour → 'busy streets, shield from noise, restrict children's independence'
becoming an organiser → 'setting up social enterprises and tackling local issues'
problems which have advantages → 'an open space may seem like an asset, it can also become a source of conflict'
aspects of neighbourhood research → 'Its research shows that…'

techniques.name: 干扰段特征
techniques.detail: 只提到相关话题但不包含题目所要求的具体信息的段落是干扰项（如 C 段谈 Living Streets 会干扰 "partnerships against crime"）。

examples.cn: → 可能干扰 "partnerships against crime"（实际答案 B）

grammar.name: 名词化
grammar.detail: 题目常用名词化形式（the number of facilities disappearing），需还原成动词短语句义。

grammar.name: 祈使句 + 并列祈使
grammar.detail: 社区号召类文本的典型句式。

examples.en: Keep calm and electing the most level-headed member
examples.cn: 保持冷静，选出最冷静的成员

grammar.name: 被动语态与定语从句
grammar.detail: 社区变化描述常用被动。

examples.en: was led by a small steering group

exercises.title: Will you love your neighbours?（A–G 段 ↔ 6 条信息）

fields.label: 1 the relationship between local environment and behaviour

exercises.limit: 答案写段落字母；字母可重复；有段落不被使用

units.title: On the move

aims.examSkills: YNNG（判断作者观点）、改述识别
aims.languageDevelopment: 旅游行业词汇、数字与单位改述

examInfo.title: Exam information: Yes / No / Not Given
points: Read the following passage. Do the statements agree with the views of the writer? Write:
YES – if the statement agrees with the views of the writer
NO – if the statement contradicts what the writer thinks
NOT GIVEN – if it is impossible to know what the writer's point of view is
关键区别：问的是「观点」而非「信息」；NO 是「矛盾」，不是「相反的陈述」。

examTips: Identify keywords in the statements. Think about the meanings and then look for paraphrases of the keywords in the text.

techniques.name: YNNG 的「观点识别」技巧
techniques.detail: 先看句子是客观事实陈述还是含观点（claim, argued, warned, believes, likely）；再识别作者转述他人观点时的标志（says, says that, warned, claimed, believes）——若题目问「作者观点」，需判断作者是否认同。

examples.en: Statement 2 "Travel agents have noticed that their customers are now more able to book their holidays." ← 原文 'customers are becoming more confident about booking packages online'
Statement 3 "After competition from low-cost airlines, business is now getting better for travel agents." ← 原文 'which have already been suffering from competition from low-cost airlines'
Statement 4 "The director thinks that travel agents are at risk of having to close." ← 原文 'warned that travel agents will have to act faster… to survive'
Statement 5 "Five years from now, there are likely to be two thirds of the amount of travel agents there are now." ← 原文 'a third fewer travel agents than now'

techniques.name: Paraphrasing 三步法
techniques.detail: 1) Identify keywords in the statements 2) Think about the meanings（换成同义说法）3) Look for paraphrases of the keywords in the text。

examples.en: a list that shows how successful an organisation is in comparison to other similar organisations
an amount expressed as a number
to calculate the position that someone or something has on a scale
to say that an event will happen
an official statement or report about something that is likely to happen

techniques.name: 题干顺序被打乱 → 必须靠语义配对
techniques.detail: Exercise 6 的定义与释义顺序与原文不同，不能按顺序读。

examples.en: 1–7 与定义配对，顺序与原文不同

techniques.name: 长句快速拆解
techniques.detail: 找主语谓语 + 剥离括号/插入语。这是阅读长难句的通用方法。

examples.en: top 10 inbound league / 337,000 (up 29%) / 35% record £694 million / £2,059 per visit / 11 nights vs six / 26.8 million / 100 million by 2025

grammar.name: 比较级与分数表达改述
grammar.detail: 数字改述是 YNNG 的高频陷阱。

examples.en: more confident / a third fewer / twice the amount / four times the amount

grammar.name: 过去分词短语作定语
grammar.detail: 学术文章常用的紧凑定语结构。

exercises.title: Do the statements agree with the views of the writer?

fields.label: Statement 2 Travel agents have noticed that their customers are now more able to book their holidays.
Statement 3 After competition from low-cost airlines, business is now getting better for travel agents.
Statement 4 The director thinks that travel agents are at risk of having to close.
Statement 5 Five years from now, there are likely to be two thirds of the amount of travel agents there are now.

exercises.limit: 答案写 YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

exercises.title: 释义与定义配对（1–7，顺序与原文不同）

fields.label: a list that shows how successful an organisation is…
an amount expressed as a number
to say that an event will happen
an official statement or report about something likely to happen

units.title: Culture
units.topic: Culture and modern society（文化与现代社会）

aims.examSkills: 特征匹配、观点与事实分类匹配、改述
aims.languageDevelopment: 引语来源标志识别（谁说的）

examInfo.title: Matching features（特征匹配）
points: Match the statements 1–6, which describe number systems in different cultures, with the cultures and languages A–F.
A Pirahã / B Munduruku / C Yupno / D Waimiri / E English / F Indian
题干顺序与原文顺序不同（The list of statements is NOT in the same order as the passage）。
有的选项会被用多次、有的选项不被使用。

examInfo.title: Matching statements to the text（观点 vs 事实）
points: 分类：A an opinion expressed by the writer / B an opinion expressed by the company or its representative / C a statement of fact by the writer / D a statement of fact by the company or its representative
关键技巧：区分「谁说的」 → 关注引语来源标志：the writer says / Dr X says / the company said / it is believed。

examTips: The passage will include paraphrases, synonyms and similar words that express the same information in the statements.
The list of statements is NOT in the same order as the passage.

techniques.name: Paraphrasing 改述对照
techniques.detail: 文章用同义改写、近义词、相似词表达与题干相同的信息。

examples.en: stealing from the organisation is frowned on in any work environment
examples.cn: → employees don't steal / dishonesty is frowned upon

examples.en: they rated equally with Western managers
examples.cn: → they were considered as good as / on a par with Western managers

examples.en: organisations and managers need to pay more attention to the completion of tasks
examples.cn: → managers need to focus more on task completion

techniques.name: 「谁说的」判断法
techniques.detail: 区分观点归属。要点：注意引号内的直接引语与其引入词。

examples.en: "The new theatre did not need more time or money to be built than had been predicted."
examples.cn: → 事实（未发生成本超支）→ C / D

examples.en: "The new building does not live up to expectations." ← 'it is also deeply disappointing'
"The money to build the new theatre came from three different sources." ← Arts Council £112.8m + 两 thirds regional development agency
"Performances are not about perfection but about sharing experiences."
examples.cn: → 观点（引自建筑评论家）→ B

techniques.name: 观点性表述的干扰特征
techniques.detail: 句子中若含 but、does not live up to、not about X but about Y → 多为观点性表述。

examples.en: There's more to theatre than the play.
But it is also deeply disappointing.

techniques.name: Matching features 通用技巧
techniques.detail: 先读所有选项（文化名）建立印象，再逐条在原文中找「特征词」。

examples.en: 1 people do not really learn how to count, because there is no need → Pirahã
2 The most used system was started by these people → English
3 The counting system works with small sets but uses addition → Munduruku
4 demonstrates that people can estimate quantities even in cultures where exact numbers do not exist → Munduruku / Indian
5 has been in existence for a very long time but may not be the best one → Indian
6 different from that in most other cultures → Yupno / Waimiri

grammar.name: 同位语（引号内）
grammar.detail: 同位语紧跟名词，用于补充说明身份。

examples.en: the RSC's artistic director, "is about experiences 'shared in the same space in real time'"

grammar.name: 定语从句与分词状语
grammar.detail: which / who 引导定语从句；分词短语作状语。

examples.en: a message which has been repeated often by the staff showing people round the building
examples.cn: which 定语从句 + 分词状语

examples.en: drama starts at the front door, and should unfold every step towards your seat

grammar.name: 被动语态与强调
grammar.detail: was completed on budget and on time；It is also worth saying that…

examples.en: The new building was completed on budget and on time.

exercises.title: Number systems in different cultures（A–F）

fields.label: 1 people do not really learn how to count, because there is no need
2 The most used system was started by these people
3 The counting system works with small sets but uses addition
4 demonstrates that people can estimate quantities even in cultures where exact numbers do not exist
5 has been in existence for a very long time but may not be the best one
6 different from that in most other cultures

exercises.limit: 答案写 A–F；顺序与原文不同；有选项不被使用

exercises.title: A 笔者观点 / B 公司观点 / C 笔者事实 / D 公司事实

fields.label: The new theatre did not need more time or money to be built than had been predicted.
The new building does not live up to expectations.

exercises.limit: 答案写 A / B / C / D

units.title: Practice exam
units.topic: 综合实战（限时全真模拟）

aims.languageDevelopment: 同义替换 + 干扰项识别 + 语法精度

examInfo.title: Practice exam 题型总览（各单元 Part 3 题型汇总）
points: Unit 8 (p.76) — True, False, Not Given：TRUE=证实；FALSE=证实相反；NOT GIVEN=无法得知；只依据原文，不用个人知识
Unit 9 (p.84) — Matching information：段落 A–G，题干可重复使用同一字母；有段落不匹配任何信息；答案写段落字母
Unit 10 (p.92) — Yes / No / Not Given：判断作者观点：YES=一致；NO=矛盾；NG=无法判断作者观点
Unit 11 (p.100) — Matching features：匹配文化/语言 A–F；题干顺序与原文顺序不同；有选项不被使用

examTips: 全书 Exam tip 通用：Exam skills | Understanding types of words; Predicting answers; Skimming for gist; Scanning for information; Completing a summary
watchOuts: U4 p.35：Think about when and how a word is used – not just the meaning of a word.
U5 p.43：Learning prefixes is a useful way to work out the meaning of specific details.
U6 p.51：Knowing the origins of a word can help you work out its meaning.
U6 p.52：The noun for a person who works in a particular science often ends in -er or -ist. Another common ending is -ian.
U7 p.60：Remember to learn the correct spelling of new words. Incorrect spelling means an incorrect answer in the exam.

techniques.name: Skimming for gist（略读抓大意）
techniques.detail: 先读标题 / 首段 / 图表标题。用于 Summary completion 前置策略。

examples.en: 读标题 → 读首段 → 读图表标题

techniques.name: Scanning for information（扫读定位）
techniques.detail: 关键词（含同义词 / 改述）→ 段落首尾句 + 信号词。

techniques.name: Predicting answers（预测答案）
techniques.detail: 从图表层级、语法位置、段落功能预测缺词。

examples.en: 冠词后 → 名词；are responsible for + → 名词

techniques.name: 干扰项特征总结
techniques.detail: 把四类题的干扰项放在一起对比记忆。

examples.cn: 多余选项 / 多余摘要 / 多余 idea（数量多于题目数）
范围过窄、只覆盖片段、「部分正确」
数字与范围的偷换（a third vs two thirds、20 percent higher vs majority）
标题只含段落中某个具体名词 → 多为细节而非主旨

exercises.title: 全真模拟（限时 60 分钟 / 40 题）

questionTypes.name: Matching Headings
questionTypes.rule: 标题概括段落主旨；标题数 > 段落数（多余选项为干扰）

questionTypes.name: Summary completion
questionTypes.rule: 先 skim 定位相关段落；预测缺词词性；注意字数限制；关键词摘要拼写须与原文一致

questionTypes.name: Short-answer questions
questionTypes.rule: 用文中细节作答，答案须为短语而非句子

questionTypes.name: Matching summaries
questionTypes.rule: 扫读配对；有 2 个多余摘要为干扰项

questionTypes.name: Matching sentence endings
questionTypes.rule: 用开头句末词预测下一个语法词；开头多于结尾（有干扰）

questionTypes.name: Multiple-choice questions
questionTypes.rule: 指令会说明有几项正确（one/two/three）

questionTypes.name: Matching information
questionTypes.rule: 匹配想法/信息到段落；有多余 idea；一个段落可匹配多条；部分段落不被匹配

questionTypes.name: Completing diagrams
questionTypes.rule: 每格不超过 4 词；图表不一定涵盖全部原文信息

questionTypes.name: True / False / Not Given

questionTypes.name: Yes / No / Not Given
